name: com.c3ngav3r.fixer-unity
description: Zero-credit local Unity assistant with Console Fixer, AI Builder and Game Builder. v1.0.4 adds a deterministic VR jetpack builder/repair that writes JetpackController.cs, waits for Unity compilation, reuses the existing player Rigidbody, auto-finds the player/head, wires XR controls, audio and lightweight thrusters, and cleans failed empty JetpackController objects without creating a second player or Rigidbody.
